vocabulary.note_ar: حرف h صامت: /ˈɒnɪst/، لذلك نقول an honest man.
vocabulary.note_en: The 'h' is silent: an honest man.
vocabulary.example: To be honest, I didn't like the film.
In my opinion, the plan is good.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making you annoyed because you can't change something

vocabulary.example: She didn't reply to my message.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay no attention to someone or something

vocabulary.example: Don't mention the test – she's still upset.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something like petrol that gives power to a machine
vocabulary.example: The car is low on fuel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: gas or smoke with a strong smell
vocabulary.example: The fumes from the cars made me cough.
After the long walk we were exhausted.

vocabulary.note_ar: تهجئتها: c واحدة و s اثنتان.
vocabulary.example: Is it necessary to bring my passport?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move or do something quickly
vocabulary.example: Hurry, or we'll miss the bus!

vocabulary.meaning_en: the pedal you press to make a car go faster

fine_lines.title: bang on about vs rub it in
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما عن تكرار الكلام بشكل مزعج. bang on about something = يتحدث عن موضوع مراراً حتى يُملّ الناس. rub it in = يكرر ذكر شيء يريد الآخر نسيانه (مثل خسارته أو خطئه).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are about annoying repetition. 'Bang on about something' = keep talking about a topic until people are bored. 'Rub it in' = keep mentioning something another person wants to forget, like their mistake.

examples.sentence: He keeps banging on about his new car.
Yes, I failed the test – don't rub it in!

fine_lines.title: so done with vs running on fumes
fine_lines.explanation_ar: so done with something = ضاق صدرك ومللت من شيء ولا تريد الاستمرار فيه. running on fumes = منهك تماماً لكنك ما زلت تستمر (أو آلة بلا وقود تقريباً).
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'So done with something' = bored and fed up with it, you don't want to continue. 'Running on fumes' = extremely tired but still going, or a machine almost out of fuel.

examples.sentence: I'm so done with this homework.
I slept three hours – I'm running on fumes.

expressions.meaning_ar: افعل ما تراه مناسباً لك؛ كن على طبيعتك (لن أحاول تغييرك)
expressions.meaning_en: do what you want; be yourself (I won't try to change you)
expressions.example: You want to wear a hat in summer? You do you.

expressions.meaning_ar: بصراحة (عبارة عامية قبل قول رأي صادق)
expressions.meaning_en: informal: 'to be honest', used before giving an honest opinion
expressions.example: Not gonna lie, that was the best soup I've ever had.

expressions.meaning_ar: يتحدث عن شيء مراراً بشكل مزعج
expressions.meaning_en: to keep talking about something in a boring or annoying way
expressions.example: She's always banging on about healthy food.

expressions.meaning_en: when someone reads your message but doesn't reply
expressions.example: I sent him a question this morning and he left me on read.

expressions.meaning_ar: وما إلى ذلك، وأشياء من هذا القبيل
expressions.meaning_en: and so on; and other similar things
expressions.example: We need tents, sleeping bags, torches and all that jazz.

expressions.meaning_en: bored and annoyed by something; you don't want to do it any more
expressions.example: I'm so done with waiting for this bus.

expressions.meaning_ar: يذكّر شخصاً بشيء يريد نسيانه (خسارة أو خطأ)
expressions.meaning_en: to keep mentioning something another person wants to forget
expressions.example: OK, you won the game – there's no need to rub it in.

expressions.meaning_ar: منهك تماماً لكنه مستمر؛ أو بلا وقود تقريباً
expressions.meaning_en: very tired with no energy left but still going; almost out of fuel
expressions.example: After a week of night shifts, she's running on fumes.

expressions.meaning_ar: شيء غير محبوب لكن لا بد منه
expressions.meaning_en: something unpleasant that you must accept because it is needed
expressions.example: Paying taxes is a necessary evil.

expressions.meaning_en: hurry up, go faster (often when driving)
expressions.example: Step on it – the train leaves in ten minutes!

grammar.title: Informal spoken forms: gonna, wanna
grammar.explanation_ar: في الكلام العامي تُختصر going to إلى gonna و want to إلى wanna: I'm not gonna lie = I'm not going to lie. لا تستخدم هذه الصيغ في الكتابة الرسمية. وفي not gonna lie تُحذف I'm أيضاً في الكلام السريع.
grammar.explanation_en: In informal speech 'going to' becomes 'gonna' and 'want to' becomes 'wanna': I'm not gonna lie = I'm not going to lie. Don't use them in formal writing. In 'Not gonna lie' the 'I'm' is also dropped.
examples: Not gonna lie, I'm tired. = I'm not going to lie, I'm tired.
I wanna go home. = I want to go home.

questions.question: Your friend read your message two hours ago but didn't answer. You were ___.
questions.explanation_ar: left on read = قُرئت رسالتك دون رد.
questions.explanation_en: 'Left on read' means your message was read but not answered.

questions.question: 'Step on it!' What does the speaker want?
'I know I lost. Don't ___!'
questions.explanation_ar: rub it in = يذكّرك بما تريد نسيانه.
questions.explanation_en: 'Rub it in' means keep mentioning something someone wants to forget.

questions.question: Exams are not fun, but you need them. They are ___.
questions.explanation_ar: a necessary evil = شيء مزعج لكنه ضروري.
questions.explanation_en: A 'necessary evil' is unpleasant but needed.

questions.question: 'We bought plates, cups, balloons and all that jazz.' 'All that jazz' means...
questions.explanation_ar: all that jazz = وما إلى ذلك.

questions.question: He keeps talking about his holiday. He's always ___ it.
questions.explanation_ar: bang on about = يتحدث مراراً بشكل مزعج.
questions.explanation_en: 'Bang on about' means talk about something too much.

questions.question: Which is the full form of 'gonna'?
questions.explanation_ar: gonna هي الصيغة العامية لـ going to.

questions.question: 'I'm so done with this job.' The speaker feels...
questions.explanation_ar: so done with = ملّ وضاق ذرعاً.
questions.explanation_en: 'So done with' means fed up and bored.

questions.question: 'You prefer tea at midnight? You do you.' The speaker means...
questions.explanation_ar: you do you = افعل ما يناسبك.
questions.explanation_en: 'You do you' means do what you want.
